# HookTos AI

> HookTos AI is an AI hook generator and creator studio for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and TikTok. It writes 10 psychology-backed opening hooks per video with a predicted retention score, finds trending Instagram audio, and suggests niche hashtags.

HookTos AI serves content creators, social media managers and digital agencies. A free plan is available; paid plans are billed in USD (Stripe) or INR (Razorpay).

## Tools
- [AI Hook Generator](https://www.hooktos.com/): 10 hooks per idea with retention scores and SEO video descriptions
- [Trending Instagram Audio](https://www.hooktos.com/audio): viral Reels sounds ranked by growth velocity, updated daily
- [Hashtag Finder](https://www.hooktos.com/hashtag): niche hashtag stacks with reach estimates
- [Creator Directory & Billboard](https://www.hooktos.com/directory): ad slots for brands from $5/week

## Guides
- [Blog](https://www.hooktos.com/blog): hooks, trending audio, hashtags and Reels retention
